stem: In each diagram, line \( k \) is parallel to line \( l \), and line \( t \) intersects lines \( k \) and \( l \). Based on the diagrams, which statement is true?

options.label: A
options.text: The value of \( x \) is 79, because the two angles shown in each diagram are congruent.

options.label: B
options.text: The value of \( x \) is 101, because the two angles shown in each diagram are supplementary.

options.label: C
options.text: The value of \( x \) is greater than 90, because the two angles shown in each diagram are obtuse angles.

options.label: D
options.text: The value of \( x \) is 11, because the two angles shown in each diagram are complementary.

visual_elements: Diagram with 4 pairs of parallel lines labeled k and l, line t intersects both k and l. Angles marked 113°, 127°, 79°, and x° as shown in the image.
